# Pietrobon & Michel

> Dental technology laboratory in Zurich, Switzerland. Precision restorations for dental clinicians since 1998.

Pietrobon & Michel is a boutique dental laboratory at Bahnhofstrasse 35, Zurich. The practice deliberately limits the number of partner clinicians to guarantee individual attention on every case. Specialisations include complex aesthetics, implantology, and full-mouth rehabilitation. Colour analyses are conducted in natural daylight. The team works exclusively by appointment.

- [For Clinicians](https://www.pietrobonundmichel.ch/fuer-behandler): Information for dental practices seeking a laboratory partner
- [For Patients](https://www.pietrobonundmichel.ch/fuer-patienten): Information for patients invited for a colour analysis
- [Visit & Contact](https://www.pietrobonundmichel.ch/besuch-kontakt): Address, opening hours, laboratory closure dates, and contact details
